goals: Talk about past events using the past simple (regular -ed and common irregular verbs).
Tell a short story in order with at first, after that, suddenly, finally.
Keep a story going with listener reactions like 'And then what happened?'

easy: What did you eat for breakfast today?
What time did you go to bed last night?
medium: What did you do last weekend?
Where did you go on your last holiday?
What did you do for Chinese New Year this year?
hard: Tell me about a funny thing that happened to you recently.
What was your life like when you were a kid?
Tell me about a day when everything went wrong.

key_phrases.en: What did you do last weekend?

key_phrases.zh: 你一定不敢相信發生了什麼事。

grammar.point_en: Past simple: regular -ed verbs and common irregular verbs
grammar.point_zh: 過去式：規則動詞加 -ed 和常見不規則動詞
grammar.explain_zh: 中文的動詞不會變化，靠「昨天」、「了」來表示過去。英文的動詞本身要改成過去式，就算句子裡已經有 yesterday 也一樣。大部分動詞加 -ed（walk → walked），但很多常用動詞是不規則的（go → went、see → saw、eat → ate）。問句和否定句用 did，後面的動詞要回到原形。

examples.en: I watched a movie last night.
We went to the night market on Saturday.
I didn't go to work yesterday.

common_mistake.wrong: Yesterday I go to the market.
common_mistake.right: Yesterday I went to the market.
common_mistake.why_zh: 就算有 yesterday，動詞還是要改成過去式。英文的時間要靠動詞本身表現。

sound_focus.sentence: I stayed home, watched a movie, and waited for my friend.

mini_lesson: Step 1 (5 min): Warm-up. Ask 2-3 warm-up questions. Don't correct yet; just note which past-tense verbs she uses or misses.

Step 2 (8 min): -ed sounds. Draw three columns: /t/ (watched, walked), /d/ (stayed, happened), /ɪd/ (visited, waited). Say each word, she repeats. Then she sorts cooked, played, needed, cleaned, wanted, shopped into the columns and reads them aloud.
Step 3 (7 min): Irregular verbs. Quick drill: you say go, see, eat, have, take, meet, buy; she answers went, saw, ate, had, took, met, bought and makes one short sentence with each.
Step 4 (5 min): Story order. Model a 4-sentence story about your weekend using At first / After that / Suddenly / Finally. She builds her own 4-sentence story with the same words.
Step 5 (5 min): Listener reactions. Tell a short story in small pieces; after each piece she reacts with 'Really?' or 'And then what happened?' Then switch roles.

roleplays.title: Monday Morning Chat
roleplays.setup_zh: 星期一早上在公司茶水間遇到同事，聊聊週末做了什麼。

lines.en: Morning! How was your weekend?
It was good, thanks. I stayed home on Saturday.
lines.zh: 很好，謝謝。我星期六待在家。

lines.en: Nice and relaxing. What did you do on Sunday?
I went to ___ with my ___.
Oh, that sounds fun! Did you eat anything good?
Yes! We ate ___. It was delicious.
I'm jealous. I just cleaned my apartment all weekend.
Oh no! Maybe next weekend will be better.
lines.zh: 喔不！也許下個週末會比較好。

roleplays.title: You Won't Believe What Happened
roleplays.setup_zh: 跟朋友講一件最近發生的倒楣事：手機忘在計程車上。朋友會一直追問細節，用過去式把故事說完。

lines.en: Hey, you look tired. Is everything OK?
You won't believe what happened yesterday.
lines.zh: 你一定不敢相信我昨天發生了什麼事。

lines.en: Oh no. What happened?
At first, everything was fine. I took a taxi to ___.
lines.zh: 一開始一切都很好。我搭計程車去___。

lines.en: OK. And then?
After that, I paid and got out. Suddenly, I realized my phone was gone!
lines.zh: 之後我付錢下車。突然，我發現手機不見了！

lines.en: No way! What did you do?
I borrowed a phone at a convenience store and called my number.
lines.zh: 我在便利商店借電話，打我自己的號碼。

lines.en: Smart. Did anyone answer?
Finally, the driver answered. Long story short, he brought it back!
lines.zh: 最後司機接了。長話短說，他把手機送回來了！

lines.en: Wow, you were lucky. So what did you learn?
Next time, I'll check my bag before I get out!
lines.zh: 下次下車前，我一定會先檢查包包！

teacher_twists: Ask for extra detail at any point ('What time was it?', 'Where were you going?'); she must answer in the past tense.
Change the ending: say 'Wait, so the driver never answered?' so she has to invent a new ending with 'Finally, ...'.
Pretend you didn't hear ('Sorry, you lost your what?') so she repeats the key sentence clearly, with the -ed ending.

homework_zh: 用 At first / After that / Suddenly / Finally 寫一個 5 句的小故事，主題是你上週末做的事，下次上課唸給老師聽。
練習 -ed 的三種發音：每天把 stayed、watched、visited 各唸 5 次，用手機錄音，聽聽看結尾有沒有發出來。
看一段 2 分鐘的英文影片或 vlog，記下 5 個過去式動詞。
